title: Investigating the Intercellular Communication Network of Immune Cell in Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome with Sepsis.
authors: Tao, Pei; He, Jinzhou; Ai, Tao; Fan, Yinghong; Zeng, Wei
journal: Computational and mathematical methods in medicine
one_liner_zh: 基于单细胞RNA测序构建脓毒症相关ARDS免疫细胞通讯网络，虽涉及转录因子STAT但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is recognized as a serious public health issue that results in respiratory failure and high mortality rates. The syndrome is characterized by immune cell aggregation, communication, activation, and alveolar epithelial damage. To elucidate the complex dynamic process of the immune system's response in ARDS, we construct the intercellular communication network of immune cells in ARDS based on a single-cell RNA sequencing dataset (including three sepsis-induced ARDS patients and four sepsis-only patients). The results show that macrophages relayed most of the intercellular signals (ligand-receptor pairs) in both groups. Many genes related to immune response (IFI44L, ISG, and HLA-DQB1) and biological functions (response to virus, negative regulation of viral life cycle, and response to interferon-beta) were detected via differentially expressed gene analysis of macrophages between the two groups. Deep analysis of the intercellular signals related to the macrophage found that sepsis-induced ARDS harbored distinctive intercellular signals related to chemokine-chemokine receptors (CCL3/4/5-CCR1), which mainly are involved in the disturbance of the STAT family transcription factors (TFs), such as STAT2 and STAT3. These signals and downstream TFs might play key roles in macrophage M1/M2 polarization in the process of sepsis-induced ARDS. This study provides a comprehensive view of the intercellular communication landscape between sepsis and sepsis-induced ARDS and identifies key intercellular communications and TFs involved in sepsis-induced ARDS. We believe that our study provides valuable clues for understanding the immune response mechanisms of ARDS.
abstract_zh: 急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）被视为一种严重的公共卫生问题，导致呼吸衰竭和高死亡率。该综合征的特征包括免疫细胞聚集、通讯、激活以及肺泡上皮损伤。为阐明ARDS中免疫系统反应的复杂动态过程，我们基于单细胞RNA测序数据集（包括三名脓毒症诱导的ARDS患者和四名仅脓毒症患者）构建了ARDS中免疫细胞的细胞间通讯网络。结果显示，在两组中，巨噬细胞传递了大部分细胞间信号（配体-受体对）。通过两组间巨噬细胞的差异表达基因分析，检测到许多与免疫反应相关的基因（IFI44L、ISG和HLA-DQB1）及生物学功能（对病毒的反应、病毒生命周期的负调控和对干扰素-β的反应）。对与巨噬细胞相关的细胞间信号的深入分析发现，脓毒症诱导的ARDS具有独特的与趋化因子-趋化因子受体（CCL3/4/5-CCR1）相关的细胞间信号，这些信号主要涉及STAT家族转录因子（TFs）的干扰，如STAT2和STAT3。这些信号及下游TFs可能在脓毒症诱导的ARDS过程中对巨噬细胞M1/M2极化发挥关键作用。本研究提供了脓毒症与脓毒症诱导的ARDS之间细胞间通讯格局的全面视角，并识别了参与脓毒症诱导的ARDS的关键细胞间通讯和TFs。我们相信，我们的研究为理解ARDS的免疫反应机制提供了有价值的线索。
